derivedGlobalFailureClassification: SCOPE_CORRECTION_ONLY. Bound http-capture-joins.ts lines25-32 collect every envelope with the same stable run/guidance ID, including later primary versions, then require every generatedAt <= earlier generation start. Three old reroute baselines span later primary3; delay warmup also spans profile1/profile2. All four fail only that broad first check; exact call/hash/model/time/options checks remain true. Preserve raw16 PASS/4 FAIL/1 NOT_RUN; this is not a replacement overall verdict.
scopeLimits: Original-normal raw KO PASS/EN FAIL and additive-en raw KO FAIL/EN PASS remain unchanged; complementary coverage does not rewrite the frozen per-run oracle.
Reroute roots retain ambiguousRetrievalJoin:true while citation-filtered publication joins report false. Do not claim unique whole-trace association or captured HTTP producer input.
Actual model returned selection0 and the service mapped it to exact reviewed text; no free-form prose-generation claim.
No physical UI/audio, full case26, delay acceptance, broad regression or overall gate verdict. Separate module EQ002-specific acceptance remains unobserved.

originalNormalEnglishPrecondition.explanation: Both original normal final snapshots have WORKER-B preferredLocale en and currentGuidance null; only WORKER-A ko is impacted/published. Raw EN FAIL is an unmet locale-coverage predicate, not an observed failure to generate for an English guidance target. Separate supported WORKER-A profile version2 English cases are actual additive positives; original predicates remain unchanged.
